strings.action.focus_dock: Focus the dock or the terminal
strings.action.harmonize_less: Harmonize: less (program colors closer to their own)
strings.action.harmonize_more: Harmonize: more (program colors closer to the theme)
strings.action.install_claude_skill: Install the fterm skill for Claude Code
strings.action.plan_review_mode: Review the plans of Claude Code: ask, always, never
strings.action.toggle_original_colors: Original colors of programs on or off
strings.action.toggle_remote_control: Remote control on or off for this pane
strings.agent.error_body: The task ended with an error.
strings.box.access: Allow {who} to read and type into other panes?
strings.box.access_keys: Enter = allow, A = always allow {name}, Esc = no
strings.box.access_why: It can see their text and run commands there.
strings.box.ai_key_keys: Enter = save, Esc = cancel (an empty key deletes the saved one)
strings.box.ai_key_where: It goes to the Windows Credential Manager, not to a file.
strings.box.config_error_end: The old config is still used. Fix the file and save it. Any key closes this.
strings.box.hooks: Add the fterm hooks to Claude Code?
strings.box.hooks_backup: as settings.json.bak-fterm. New Claude Code sessions use them.
strings.box.hooks_plan: PreToolUse (ExitPlanMode) shows the plans of plan mode in a Review tab.
strings.box.hooks_stay: Your other settings and hooks stay. The old file is kept
strings.box.plan_editor: (there Ctrl+G edits the plan in your editor)
strings.box.plan_review: R = review it here, item by item
strings.box.restore_keys: Enter = restore, Esc = no (Ctrl+Shift+S: all sessions)
strings.box.save_session_keys: Enter = save, Esc = cancel. A saved session stays in the list (Ctrl+Shift+S).
strings.toast.ai_not_sent_body: on_ai_request in your config stopped it.
strings.toast.command_copied_body: The command is copied. Paste it where you need it.
strings.toast.config_error_kept:
{error}
The old config is still used.
strings.toast.gpu_restart: Restart fterm for the new gpu settings
strings.toast.gpu_restart_body: gpu.backend and gpu.power are used when fterm starts.
strings.toast.harmonize_body: harmonize = { strength = {value} } in fterm.lua keeps it. Ctrl+Shift+] more, Ctrl+Shift+[ less.
strings.toast.history_off_body: Turn it on with history = { enabled = true } in the config.
strings.toast.hooks_added: The fterm hooks are in Claude Code
strings.toast.hooks_added_body: {path}. Start Claude Code again to use them.
strings.toast.hooks_already: The fterm hooks are already there
strings.toast.hooks_read_error: Cannot read the Claude Code settings
strings.toast.hooks_write_error: Cannot write the Claude Code settings
strings.toast.no_saved_sessions_body: A session is saved when fterm closes, or with "{action}".
strings.toast.not_restored_body: on_restore in your config said no.
strings.toast.plan_question_body: R = review it in fterm, Esc = the dialog of {agent}
strings.toast.plan_review_always: Each plan of plan mode opens in a Review tab. plan_review = "{mode}" in fterm.lua keeps it.
strings.toast.plan_review_ask: fterm asks first: R = review, Esc = the dialog of Claude Code. plan_review = "{mode}" in fterm.lua keeps it.
strings.toast.plan_review_never: Claude Code shows its own dialog. plan_review = "{mode}" in fterm.lua keeps it.
strings.toast.program_runs: A program runs in this pane
strings.toast.program_runs_body: The text is copied. Paste it where you need it.
strings.toast.recording: Recording the output of every pane
strings.toast.recording_body: FTERM_RECORD: {folder}. It can have secrets; remove FTERM_RECORD when you are done.
strings.toast.remote_off_body: No program can read or type into this pane.
strings.toast.remote_on_body: Programs can ask to read and type into this pane.

toast.reruns_body.one: A pane ran a program: its command is in the prompt again. Press Enter to run it.
toast.reruns_body.other: {n} panes ran programs: their commands are in the prompt again. Press Enter to run them.

strings.toast.skill_foreign: A different fterm skill is there
strings.toast.skill_foreign_body: {path} is not from fterm, so it is not changed. The fterm skill is in the clipboard.
strings.toast.skill_installed: The fterm skill for Claude Code is installed
strings.toast.skill_installed_body: {path}. Claude Code uses it in new sessions.
strings.toast.skill_up_to_date: The fterm skill is up to date
strings.toast.stays_open_body: Closing was stopped by on_close_window in your config. Press × again to close anyway.
strings.toast.text_to_command_prompt: Text to command works at the prompt of a shell.
strings.toast.theme_colors_body: The colors of programs fit the theme (harmonize).
strings.toast.type_task_body: Write what you want in the prompt (for example: find the 10 biggest files), then press Ctrl+Shift+G.
